messages:
mia: Heads-up — noticed double-credit in prod when a stream slice + toolcall truncation happen together. Minimal repro in staging, can someone eyeball?

raj: yikes. session id? is this reconnect/resume path or routing swap?

mia: session s-7f3b. sequence looks like: client stream -> runtime slices chunks -> toolcall invoked -> upstream returns EOF during the toolcall -> client reconnects/resumes and we replay the suffix + re-invoke the toolcall. Logs: ```TRACE s-7f3b: emit chunk 12 len=128
TOOLCALL start id=tc-42
UPSTREAM EOF at offset 1024
RECONNECT new sid s-7f3b-1
TOOLCALL start id=tc-42 (replay)
```

alex: so idempotency for toolcalls isn't preserved across resume? i thought we dedup by toolcall id.

sara: we do TTL-dedupe toolcall ids for 30s, but the resume path currently issues a new ephemeral tool token (router side) which bypasses the dedupe. my hunch: the handoff creates a fresh token, ledger treats it as a new toolcall record -> double billing.

mia: confirmed from the staging trace: resume allocates ephemeral token via router that doesn't map to original toolcall id. ledger shows two distinct records and streaming-meter logs count both suffix + replay.

raj: options: 1) carry original toolcall id through the resume handshake so router can map back; 2) mark replayed toolcalls as provisional and reconcile when we get confirmation; 3) surface provisional vs confirmed credits in console UX to make ops aware.

alex: option 2 adds reconciliation complexity and SLA risk. option 1 seems simpler: propagate `origin_toolcall_id` over resume and normalize at the router/ledger boundary.

sara: patch plan: router sets `toolcall.record_id = incoming.tool_id || resume.origin_tool_id`. small ledger dedupe on `record_id` should collapse the duplicate. i'll open a PR adding that mapping + unit tests.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: branch/sara/tool-resume-dedupe -> staging @ 2024-11-02T03:00:00Z :rocket:

mia: :thumbsup: i'll run the staging repro once that's deployed. can we also add a quick dashboard alert: "duplicate toolcall counts per session > 1 in 5m"? this is the observable our customers will notice.

raj: suggested metric: per session, `count(distinct toolcall.record_id) / count(toolcall)` or simply flag sessions with `count(toolcall) > 1 AND eof+resume events > 0`. keep it cheap.

alex: also worth considering: if we suppress prefix replay at runtime (cache hit), we might avoid reissuing the toolcall entirely. that's invasive to runtime caching.

sara: i'll include a feature-flagged metric + a console tile in the PR (off by default). also adding an audit log line on resume that contains `origin_toolcall_id` so we can run retro-onboarding queries for affected customers.

mia: thanks — tagging oncall for visibility. this impacts a handful of enterprise customers, so i'll post a short incident note if we see repros in prod after changes.
